items.title: Build combat HUD with hand, intent, and action log
items.notes: Completed: combat HUD with engine-wired hand tray, intent preview stack, and last-turn action log.

items.title: Implement word entry UX (compose, submit, pass, feedback)
items.notes: Completed: manual word entry UX with compose rail, selectable hand letters, undo/clear, submit, pass, and strict-dictionary feedback.

items.title: Design reward and shop modal flows
items.notes: Implemented reward and shop modal flows with progression store, reward pick (3 options), shop buy/remove deck mutations, and map/combat wiring for post-victory rewards.

items.title: Set up local board automation and handoff workflow
items.notes: Added board CLI commands, board integrity check, and handoff snapshot workflow.

items.title: Implement run save envelope and adapter
items.notes: Completed: schema-versioned save envelope with checksum, atomic temp->current write, current/previous fallback load, and clear operation with typed error reasons plus unit tests.

items.title: Add resume gate and recovery UX
items.notes: Completed: startup resume/abandon dialog with store hydration from save payload, save status badge (Saving/Saved/Failed), load/write error messaging, and debounced autosave persistence.

items.title: Complete reward and shop progression flow
items.notes: Completed: encounter outcome checks, reward/shop progression wiring, explicit run-end victory/defeat overlay, and new-run reset path across map/combat/progression stores.

items.title: Enforce map generation contract and fairness
items.notes: Seed determinism, route guarantees, and config validation.

items.title: Implement Duelist and Arcanist hero definitions
items.notes: Hero contracts, starter decks, starter relics, and run init wiring.

items.title: Add hero signature mechanics and logs
items.notes: Deterministic signature hooks and action-log clarity.

items.title: Build meta progression profile and unlock flow
items.notes: Meta profile, deterministic currency awards, unlock transactions.

items.title: Create meta progression UI
items.notes: Currency panel, unlock list, prerequisites, and feedback states.

items.title: Add deterministic integration and smoke tests
items.notes: Encounter integration, save/resume regression, and one E2E smoke path.

items.title: Configure CI quality gates and traceability links
items.notes: Required lint/test/build checks and requirement-to-test linkage docs.

items.title: Re-theme UI to parchment/tabletop aesthetic and fix combat layout bugs
items.notes: Replaced dark dungeon gradient theme with flat parchment/ink palette; fixed dead-CSS layout bug causing duplicate combat panel and hidden Cast/Pass buttons; rebuilt map as Slay-the-Spire-style connected circular icon nodes; added HeroSelectScreen gating boot and post-run flow; reworked arena to hero-left/enemy-right layout with name banners, inline intent chip, turn-phase stepper, fanned hand with tabletop-style Wild/Enemy Vowel cards, big-hit damage juice, and legible victory/defeat overlay; removed redundant action log and map footer panel.

items.title: Spec, design, and implement a first-run tutorial mode
items.notes: Implemented step-driven TutorialOverlay (spec 010): step config array, tutorialSeen localStorage flag, replay via Help button in CombatHud. Covers hand, splay left/right, Wild letter input, Enemy Vowel, Items, and enemy intent. Tests cover step-advancement and persisted-seen flag.
